Europe PMC.note: The public API supplied systematic date-bounded discovery, abstracts, publication dates, affiliations, and stable metadata.

Nature / Scientific Reports.note: The sleep-report article page, DOI, date, authors, and abstract were accessible; the current early unedited page did not expose detailed result tables.

Nature / Communications Medicine.note: The cancer extraction article was accessible and cross-checked against Europe PMC full text.

Oxford Academic / JAMIA Open.note: Full text and tables for the sequential multi-site fine-tuning study were accessible.

PubMed.note: E-Utilities supplied current records, abstracts, electronic dates, authorship, and identifiers; one focused batch was rate-limited after several successful calls.

Wiley DOI.note: The anti-amyloid pharmacovigilance DOI was inconsistently indexed in search; PubMed supplied the stable record and abstract.

LinkedIn.note: Public indexing is incomplete and was used only for discovery.

arXiv.note: The date-bounded API supplied current submissions; health-relevant agent, foundation-model, and privacy results produced no additional qualifying item.

medRxiv.note: The date-bounded API supplied current records and metadata; no August 20-22 candidate cleared the full intersection and novelty gates.

FDA.note: The TEMPO participant announcement and program materials were accessible; no participant-level protocol or result was public.

CMS.note: ACCESS model, accepted-applicant, provider, and technical pages were accessible.

Dexcom.note: The official participant announcement and product description were accessible; claims were treated as manufacturer-authored.

Black Swan Causal Labs.note: The public reading page was accessible; no clearly dated in-window item cleared the inclusion gate.

Oxford Academic / Open Forum Infectious.note: Complete article text, methods, results, limitations, DOI, and publication date were accessible.

Springer / PharmacoEconomics.note: The official DOI, primary abstract, PMID, publication date, affiliations, methods summary, and results were accessible; publisher full text required a subscription.

Wiley / Clinical Pharmacology & Therapeu.note: The official DOI, primary abstract, PMID, publication date, affiliations, methods summary, and results were accessible; publisher full text required a subscription.

ASCO / JCO Clinical Cancer Informatics.note: The official journal abstract, DOI, PMID, authors, publication date, methods summary, and results were accessible; publisher full text required a subscription.

Stanford frontier health AI.note: Stanford Medicine AI News, RAISE Health, AIMI, HAI, James Zou laboratory sources, and linked primary artifacts were accessible; no newly indexed August 20-22 institutional artifact independently cleared the full gate.

bioRxiv.note: The date-bounded API and current version pages supplied DrugEvolve, BioPathfinder v2, and BioChirp v2 with dates, revision notes, abstracts, identifiers, and linked code.

NCBI PMC.note: Complete open article text supplied methods, results, limitations, identifiers, and source links for the clinical-trial source-document-verification study.

GitHub / MacAma.note: The public repository exposed the workflow, code structure, case-study resources, benchmark materials, execution requirements, and MIT license.

Smart Medicine / Wiley.note: The DOI and bibliographic record were verified; the complete open article was available through PMC.

JMIR.note: Complete open XML supplied methods, results, limitations, dates, authorship, and identifiers for the LabBridge and oncology-guideline studies.

GitHub / LLMADE.note: The public repository exposed the Chinese clinical-note ADE corpus, knowledge base, code, and documentation.

GitHub / RRBench.note: The public repository exposed benchmark tasks, reference scripts, agent code, evaluator, tests, and license; safeguarded cohort data remain separate.

PLOS One.note: The peer-reviewed CAVE-Onc article, date, methods, results, limitations, data statements, and supporting files were accessible through PMC and DOI metadata.

GitHub / CAVE-Onc.note: The MIT-licensed repository exposed code, benchmark data, tests, evaluation artifacts, provenance, manuscript files, and reproduction commands.

GitHub / LLM evidence retrieval bias.note: The public repository exposed unchanged model responses, review-specific analyses, curated artifacts, figures, benchmark tooling, and a demo; licensed Cochrane source packages are not redistributed.

BMJ Open.note: Complete open text, tables, methods, results, limitations, DOI, PMID, and PMCID were accessible through PMC and journal metadata.

Elsevier / Transfusion Clinique et Biolo.note: The DOI exposed an Elsevier linking page rather than complete article text; PubMed supplied the complete primary abstract, date, results, and PMID, and Crossref supplied journal and authorship metadata.

Crossref.note: DOI metadata, publication dates, journal titles, authors, licenses, and canonical links were accessible.

JBJS Open Access.note: The peer-reviewed version of record, DOI, publication date, and open full text were verified through the journal record and PMC.

GitHub / agentic systematic review.note: Four MIT-licensed repositories exposed the modular deduplication, screening, extraction, and verification implementations and documented their local and model-service requirements.

Elsevier / Journal of Critical Care.note: The full article was not publicly accessible during this run; the primary PubMed record supplied the abstract, publication date, methods summary, results, DOI, PMID, and authorship.

GitHub / DrugEvolve.note: The Apache-2.0 repository exposed agent roles, execution flow, lineage and memory, configuration, security guidance, and before-and-after implementations for the evaluated applications.

GitHub / BioPathfinder.note: The public release and linked bioRxiv artifact exposed the v2 code-availability statement and the evidence-to-experiment workflow.

GitHub / BioChirp.note: The public repository and linked v2 preprint exposed the interpretation-execution architecture and evaluation artifacts.

Elsevier / Journal of Biomedical Informa.note: Complete publisher text for two articles was not publicly accessible; primary PubMed records supplied abstracts, dates, results, identifiers, and authorship.

Oxford Academic / European Heart Journal.note: The accepted-manuscript page exposed the abstract, cohort, methods, results, date, DOI, and authorship; the PDF route was not consistently accessible.

Wiley / Learning Health Systems.note: The DOI and primary PubMed record supplied the abstract, publication date, methods, results, DOI, PMID, and authorship.

note: Source limitations do not imply that an inaccessible social account or page contained no new material.
